items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: But I used Dan Grisson on the sax.

ctx.x: I could name a lot of them. But I was taking up a lot of times, trying to help the guys voicing that six-part. They didn't have any knowledge in that. Then I wrote a lot of things where we used five saxes, too. But I used Dan Grisson on the sax.
